Annotation Interface Transactional

@Target({ANNOTATION_TYPE,METHOD,TYPE}) @Retention(RUNTIME) @Around @Type(TransactionalInterceptor.class) public @interface Transactional
Micronaut alternative jakarta.transaction.Transactional annotation. Internally jakarta.transaction.Transactional it's `Javax` alternative is remapped to this annotation.
Since:
1.0
Author:
graemerocher

      int timeout

    • readOnly

      boolean readOnly
      true if the transaction is read-only.

      Defaults to false.

      This just serves as a hint for the actual transaction subsystem; it will not necessarily cause failure of write access attempts. A transaction manager which cannot interpret the read-only hint will not throw an exception when asked for a read-only transaction but rather silently ignore the hint.

      Returns:
      Whether is read-only transaction
      Default:
      false
